subject: Mobile Development
title: Haptic Feedback: Touch You Can Feel
description: One-minute skill: Haptic Feedback: Touch You Can Feel.

hook.text: Your phone vibrates subtly when you toggle a switch. That tiny buzz is haptic feedback.

buildup.text: Haptics confirm actions through the sense of touch, adding a physical layer to digital interaction.

discovery.text: Apple's Taptic Engine produces dozens of distinct vibration patterns for different events.

twist.text: Good haptics are invisible — users notice when they're wrong, but not when they're right.

climax.text: Haptic feedback makes glass screens feel more responsive and real than silent taps ever could.

punchline.text: A tiny vibration makes a glass screen feel real.

quiz.question: What does haptic feedback provide?
options: Physical confirmation of actions through vibrations
